notes.subject: כדברם
notes.rationale: 'olsem long ples pas bilong ol' (as in their pasture) o 'olsem pasin bilong ol' (after their manner) — tupela i stap.

notes.subject: גרים
notes.rationale: 'ol man i no save long hap' (strangers/sojourners) — sampla i tanim olsem 'ol binatang' o 'ol arimamil'.

notes.subject: מחים
notes.rationale: Tok 'fat' i maenim 'ol man i gat olpela bel' — ol man gutpela long wok manmeri.

translation: Na ol pikinini sipsip bai wokabaut long kaikai olsem long ples pas bilong ol, na ol man i no save long hap bai kaikai olgeta ol graun bagarap bilong ol man i gat olpela bel.
